delivery.outcome: Decompose god function compile_execution_plan in src/koru/autonomy/execution_plan.py (PLF-033): extract signal collection (_collect_plan_signals returning the signal payload plus the open tickets it was built from), pipeline order parsing (_pipeline_order), phase selection (_select_plan_work/_discovery_selection/_discovery_steps) and summary rendering (_plan_summary) into module-level helpers that communicate through the _PlanSignals/_PlanSelection NamedTuples, dropping compile_execution_plan from CC=13 / fan-out=18 / mutations=20 to CC=3 / fan-out=8 / mutations=4 (god-function thresholds: fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12) while producing an identical ExecutionPlan: same signal key order (planfile, open_refactor_tickets, skipped_likely_complete, heuristics, llm), same phase/selection precedence (first open refactor ticket wins, else first discovery phase in pipeline order, else idle), same summary strings and same function-local resolve_work_llm_context import so module-level monkeypatching in tests keeps working.
nonGoals: Refactoring the separately ticketed _queued_ticket_steps, _ticket_matches_profile and _workflow_steps smells in the same module
Changing the ExecutionPlan/ExecutionStep dataclass schema or the module's public API
Altering profile selection, ticket filtering or sorting behavior

architecture.decision: Single-level helper extraction with NamedTuple results: compile_execution_plan keeps only load/collect/select/render orchestration. The code2llm mutation heuristic counts every assignment and tuple-unpack target inside a function body, so the removed assignments (strategy_id, pipeline, order, heuristics, signals keys, steps/selected/phase mutation, summary concat) must move out of the function rather than merely be reorganized; the helpers each stay at or below fan-out 8 / mutations 4 / CC 3. The try/except function-local import of resolve_work_llm_context is preserved verbatim inside _collect_plan_signals because tests monkeypatch it on the koru.work.llm_provenance module.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single inline compile_execution_plan body.

validation.evidence: compile_execution_plan and every new helper are below the god-function thresholds in code2llm analysis of the changed file; no pre-existing function's metrics changed.
Existing execution-plan suites pass unchanged plus new discovery/idle branch regression tests.
